description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. It is a square, low-resolution raster of the Crossref publisher badge: a stylised circular ring, whose upper-left arc is light blue and whose lower-right arc is pale yellow, enclosing a red ribbon/flag shape with two downward-pointing tails. Below the ring the words "Check for" and "updates" are printed in black sans-serif type on two lines, on a pale grey-white background with a thin grey rule visible along the top and left edges. No axes, units, tick labels, scale bars, legends, micrographs, spectra, curves, maps or data labels of any kind are present, and no sample, composition or processing condition is named. Consequently the image carries no evidence about the Zr-alloyed Fe-Mn-Al-C low-density steel referred to in the paper title and abstract, and nothing about grain structure, phase constitution or strength-ductility behaviour can be read from it. No caption was extracted and no text block is linked to this figure. It should be treated as a placeholder / update-notification watermark rather than a data-bearing figure, and no measurement should be derived from it.
